 Implementing the GitHub Copilot SDK: A Security-First Guide  The GitHub Copilot SDK offers a way to place agentic software workflows inside an application instead of asking users to move every task into a separate chat or command-line session.
This implementation guide turns the earlier “copilot-sdk Review 2026: Security and Privacy” topic into an operational plan.

Pricing discussion: validate the operating model, not a stale number 
 The supplied official source confirms that standard SDK use requires a GitHub Copilot subscription unless the team uses BYOK.
It also says the standard pricing page includes a free tier with limited usage and that each prompt counts toward the same usage allowance model as Copilot CLI.
The package does not include a verified current price, so this guide does not quote one.
Before approval, check the current official pricing and usage documentation.
